key.name: position
key.description: Which part of the top bar holds the quota items: left, center or right.

key.name: bar-count
key.description: The most providers shown on the top bar. Fewer are shown when space runs out.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: auto: shrink the bar only when space runs out. always: always compact. never: never drop the percent sign and window suffix (providers may still be hidden).

key.name: theme
key.description: The id of the theme: a folder with a theme.json in themes/builtin of the extension or in ~/.local/share/gnome-ai-quota/themes. The default follows GNOME.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: system follows the GNOME light or dark preference; light and dark force one.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: system follows the GNOME clock setting; 12h and 24h force one for reset times.

key.name: reset-format
key.description: long reads "resets in 1h 20min"; short reads "resets in 1h20".

key.name: auto-open
key.description: Cards in warning, critical or error states open on their own; the choice you make by hand is kept until the state changes.

key.name: data-source
key.description: live asks the real providers that have credentials; demo shows made-up data for development.

key.name: credentials-revision
key.description: The preferences window raises this number whenever a credential is stored or removed, so the running extension asks the providers again. It holds no secret.

key.name: account-status
key.description: The running extension writes, for each real provider, how its account is doing (ok, no_key, rejected, keyring, unreachable or changed), so the preferences window can show it next to the credential. It holds no secret.

key.name: command-code-username
key.description: Your username on the Command Code site. It only builds the link to the page where API keys are created; it is not a credential.

key.name: untracked-providers
key.description: Ids of providers whose collection is paused and that are hidden from the bar and the popup. Their credentials are kept.

key.name: credentials-touched
key.description: The preferences window writes the id of the provider it stored or removed a credential for, just before it raises the revision, so the extension asks only that provider again. It holds no secret.

key.name: prefs-target
key.description: The extension writes a provider id here before it opens the preferences window, which then shows that account and clears the value.

key.name: terms-acknowledged
key.summary: Providers whose terms notice was accepted
key.description: Ids of the providers whose possible terms-of-use conflict the user confirmed before the first sign-in, so the notice is not shown again.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Tell you with a system notification when a quota crosses its threshold, and when an account has been failing for a while. Turning this off keeps the bar and the popup as they are.

key.name: alert-session-enabled
key.description: Whether a five-hour quota that crosses its threshold sends a notification.

key.name: alert-session-percent
key.description: The used percentage at which a five-hour quota sends its notification. It sends another only after the usage falls 3 points below it or the quota resets.

key.name: alert-week-enabled
key.description: Whether a weekly quota that crosses its threshold sends a notification.

key.name: alert-week-percent
key.description: The used percentage at which a weekly quota sends its notification. It sends another only after the usage falls 3 points below it or the quota resets.

key.name: alert-month-enabled
key.description: Whether a monthly quota that crosses its threshold sends a notification.

key.name: alert-month-percent
key.description: The used percentage at which a monthly quota sends its notification. It sends another only after the usage falls 3 points below it or the quota resets.

key.name: alert-credits-enabled
key.description: Whether a credit quota that crosses its threshold sends a notification.

key.name: alert-credits-percent
key.description: The used percentage at which a credit quota sends its notification. It sends another only after the usage falls 3 points below it or the quota resets.

key.name: alert-connection
key.description: Tell you once when an account has been rejected, or its data has been missing, for a while. Providers you stopped tracking never notify.

key.name: demo-scenario
key.description: Until real providers exist, the demo providers act out a scenario. steady: everything fine. flaky: errors, a rate limit and a signed-out provider, every 15 seconds. drift: usage climbs toward the limits every 10 seconds.
